lockBody: Ask for Face ID, a fingerprint or your phone's passcode each time ReproSense opens. Off by default.
lockUnavailable: This phone has no Face ID, fingerprint or passcode set up, or the check was cancelled, so the lock is still off.
status: Team scorecard and live status (opens the website)
pdfReady: The PDF is ready. Choose where to save or send it.
exportReady: Your data is ready. Choose where to save it.
pick: Pick a woman to open her app
resetDone: Demo data reset. Every fictional record is back where it started.
resetBody: Every fictional record goes back to its starting point, and records started with Join are deleted.
scanTitle: Point the camera at the clinic's QR code
scanNoCamera: The camera is off for ReproSense, so the code can't be read. You can still start a record without a clinic.
scanInvalid: That isn't a ReproSense clinic code. Try the patient QR code at the clinic desk.
reopen: Close and reopen ReproSense to finish switching the layout direction.
